correctness.rationale: The constrained minimizer is (0,0) and the gap is au+(u²+v²)/2 with Hessian I. On the default disk, q=0 forces precisely the face u=0, |y|≤√(a²+2ap). If q≠0, the asserted point on that face satisfies ball and halfspace stationarity with multipliers |q|/b>0 and p+a−p|q|/b≥0; the Lagrangian is strictly convex, proving uniqueness even at a=0. Then ||d||=||g|| and Cauchy–Schwarz makes the step the unconstrained line minimizer with 0<η≤1. Its final point has inner product ap with d (since (x₁+ae₁)·d=0); its transverse component has squared size p²(b−|q|)²/||d||². This gives the stated ratio. Its bracket is 2b²−2(ap+b|q|), hence R<2; substituting a=1, q=p³ gives R→2. On the tied face set w=p²+y², C=p(p+a). The ratio is (w−p²)/p² up to C and 1+(p+a)(a−p)/w thereafter on [p²,(p+a)²]. Monotonicity yields the two claimed maxima; continuity and y=0 give the full range. At a=p the second branch is constant, so y²=ap is a maximizer but not the only one; when a=0 the face degenerates and the ratio is zero. The off-tie limit is 2a/(p+a) and is strictly below a/p for a>p. With a=1, p=n⁻² and y=√p the step accepts the oracle output in full, with point-distance factor n and gap ratio (p/2)/(p+p²/2)=1/(2+n⁻²). Only the first update is covered. The source checker was inspected, not executed; its finite tests are ancillary to the exact reconstruction.

evidence: The first two adaptive-method results bound objective error under quadratic growth. The older distance theorem requires solution-controlled Type-I/II radius hypotheses. The projection theorem requires radius at most the Polyak radius.
broader_coverage.reasoning: For a=1,q=0 the default radius is 1+p instead of the admissible solution radius p and exceeds the Polyak radius (p+p²/2)/(1+p). The distance theorems do not apply; objective convergence is compatible with unbounded relative distance at one step.

evidence: The adaptive theorem controls the gap, which can have a term linear in normal distance at a boundary minimizer. The exact decrease and projection results both need radii smaller than the witness radius. The relaxed witness fails the exactness hypothesis.

value.rationale: The example isolates a genuine failure mode of a documented default radius and exact oracle on a fixed condition-number-one objective. The sharp unique-oracle bound shows the blowup is tied to the permitted exact selection, not simply ill-conditioning or proximity to a tie; the gap contraction rules out conflating it with failure of objective descent. This meaningfully delimits first-step point-distance guarantees without claiming anything about eventual convergence or practical tie policies.
